title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 517 Seagaze Drive in Oceanside, California, as the "Charlesetta Reece Allen Post Office Building".
official_summary: This act designates the facility of the U.S. Postal Service located at 517 Seagaze Drive in Oceanside, California, as the Charlesetta Reece Allen Post Office Building.

summary.headline: Congress renamed a Postal Service building in Oceanside, California, after Charlesetta Reece Allen.
summary.what_it_does: This law officially names the U.S. Postal Service facility at 517 Seagaze Drive in Oceanside, California, the Charlesetta Reece Allen Post Office Building. It changes only the official name of the building. It does not change postal services, mail delivery, or staffing.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on November 25, 2024, and the designation took effect on that date.
